hardware_target: 8 x H800, assuming 80 GiB per GPU
memory_limitations: 20 bytes/parameter counts BF16 weights, shared BF16 gradient/DDP buckets, FP32 masters/gradients and FP32 SOAP moments. Excludes SOAP preconditioners, optimizer temporaries, activations, logits, CUDA/NCCL and allocator overhead. DDP replicates all experts on each GPU. Verify peak memory on H800 before a full run.

excluded: ordinary Transformer elementwise terms, following the Megatron reference
top-k comparisons, integer routing counts, indexing, copies and casts are not FLOPs
